scope_note: Deployment artifacts generated by this assistant are starter outputs derived from the existing CE-RISE Digital Passport System GitOps Template. They help users map decisions to CE-RISE deployment assets and must not replace the canonical template repository or component documentation.

artifact_templates.title: Docker Compose baseline with external IO adapter
artifact_templates.description: A local Compose baseline for HEX Core Service with a pinned registry catalog and an external HTTP IO adapter endpoint.
best_for: handover from a generalized reference-example workflow
assumptions: HEX Core Service is the public-facing service.
The IO adapter is external unless the internal adapter profile is explicitly enabled.
Model registry entries are pinned in a local catalog file.

artifact_templates.title: Docker Compose internal adapter profile
artifact_templates.description: An optional Compose profile that adds the CE-RISE JSON DB storage adapter as an adopter extension point.
assumptions: The baseline still treats an external adapter endpoint as the default path.
The internal adapter profile is an extension for local or controlled environments.

artifact_templates.title: Docker Compose RE indicators profile
artifact_templates.description: An optional Compose profile that adds the existing CE-RISE RE Indicators Calculation Service beside HEX Core Service.
assumptions: The calculation service remains a separate downstream service.
HEX Core Service remains the Digital Passport system integration point.

artifact_templates.title: Kubernetes base
artifact_templates.description: A Kubernetes base for HEX Core Service, service exposure, environment configuration, and registry catalog mounting, aligned with the existing template's overlay workflow.
assumptions: Secrets are represented explicitly as examples and should be replaced by the operator's secret management workflow.

artifact_templates.title: Kubernetes development overlay
artifact_templates.description: A development overlay with debug logging, a development namespace, and insecure local auth only for non-production use.
assumptions: AUTH_MODE=none is only acceptable for a development overlay.
The IO adapter URL should be replaced with the adopter's cluster-local or external adapter endpoint.

artifact_templates.title: Kubernetes production overlay
artifact_templates.description: A production overlay with JWT/JWKS auth placeholders, replica count, resource requests, and explicit auth secret example.
assumptions: Production authentication uses JWT/JWKS by default.
Secret values must be managed by the deployment operator.

artifact_templates.title: RE indicators deployment extension
artifact_templates.description: An optional Kubernetes extension for the existing CE-RISE RE Indicators Calculation Service.
assumptions: The RE indicators service is optional and remains separate from the HEX Core Service deployment.
The extension should only be included when the passport workflow needs resource-efficiency indicator calculation.

readiness_fields.label: Target runtime

readiness_fields.description: The CE-RISE services and optional extensions required for the workflow.

readiness_fields.label: IO adapter strategy
readiness_fields.description: Whether HEX Core Service connects to an external adapter or an internal adapter profile/extension.

readiness_fields.label: Model registry strategy
readiness_fields.description: The pinned catalog entries and allowed artifact hosts used by the registry.

readiness_fields.label: Authentication strategy
readiness_fields.description: The authentication mode and secret management path, especially for production.

readiness_fields.label: Environment overlays
readiness_fields.description: The expected development, staging, and production overlays or Compose profiles.

readiness_fields.label: Operational checks
readiness_fields.description: Health, readiness, OpenAPI, registry, and integration checks to run after deployment.
